_note: MS03: D1 + D2 notes (APU port log and SPC-side trace). Union of mesen2-results/specs/D1_notes.json and D2_notes.json (disjoint files, no conflicting entries; the only change against the draft is a shorter text for comment 254403). Comments use expectOld because the stored comment is replaced on a line that already has one. 'find' must occur exactly once in the stored note.

edit.find: 13. Otherwise write APUIO2: 0 on odd frames, the dequeued sfxQueueCh1 byte on even frames
edit.with: 13. Otherwise write the sound word (16-bit store to APUIO2, so the high byte lands in APUIO3): 0 on odd frames; on even frames the dequeued word sfxQueueCh1 (low byte, APUIO2) / sfxQueueCh2 (high byte, APUIO3), and both queue bytes are cleared. A musicTransitionState of $FFFF skips the write

edit.find: (not traced: whether the fade is audible before the following $01/$F0 commands)
edit.with: (measured: the fade is audible, the engine's master volume steps from $53 to 0 over about 335 frames; the $01 sent after the $F1 echo does not interrupt it, because the engine's last-command byte $08 already holds $01; the engine's fade-end code then runs CmdStop, which writes 0 to APUIO0, and only then does the thinker send $F0)

edit.find: so the handshake costs a few frames but never blocks the main loop. Not traced: whether the fade is audible before SpcTransferMusicData's $F0 stop arrives one or two frames later.
edit.with: so the handshake never blocks the main loop, but the fade-out leg lasts about 340 frames. Measured: the $01 in step 2 has no effect while the engine's last-command byte ($08) already holds $01, so the fade started by $F1 runs to its end and is audible (master volume $53 to 0 in about 335 frames). The engine's fade-end code then calls CmdStop, which writes 0 to APUIO0; that zero is what step 2 waits for, so SpcTransferMusicData's $F0 follows the end of the fade, not one or two frames after the $01. While the main loop is blocked inside a dialogue wait the thinker does not run and the zero is read later.

254403.text: $01 after the $F1 echo: ignored while the engine's last-command byte $08 already holds $01, so the fade continues (after the upload it starts the song)

edit.find: Wait frames → optional stop command ($F2) → ready signal ($F0) → handshake poll
edit.with: Wait frames → $F2 when $0D72 is set (the engine's CmdF2: key off all voices, volumes unchanged) → $F0 (the engine's CmdStop: master and echo volume 0, echo writes off; the SPC answers 0) → handshake poll

edit.find: optional stop ($F2 + 32 frames if $0D72 set), handshake ($F0 poll, $FF)
edit.with: $F2 held for 32 frames if $0D72 is set (CmdF2: voices keyed off, the voices fall silent within 4 frames, master volume unchanged), $F0 (CmdStop) and a poll for the SPC's zero answer, $FF (jump into the resident loader, which writes no DSP register)

166812.text: Send $F2 to APU I/O port 0: the engine's CmdF2 keys off all voices (KOFF = $FF); master volume and echo stay unchanged

166817.text: Wait 32 frames ($20) with $F2 on the port (the engine re-dispatches it every tick)

166823.text: Send $F0: the engine's CmdStop (master and echo volume 0, echo writes off, EON = 0); the SPC answers 0 on port 0
